name: Ring of Elemental Command (Fire)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dominate an Fire Elemental
powers.text: 2 charges: cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Fire Elemental.

summary: Command over Fire elementals, Resistance to Fire damage, and its element's spells (save DC 18).
text: Linked with the Elemental Plane of Fire, this ring gives your attack rolls against Fire Elementals Advantage, while their attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. You also gain Resistance to Fire damage and the Ignan language. It holds 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 of them at each dawn. For 2 charges you can target a Fire Elemental with Dominate Monster (save DC 18). Other spells it casts, with their charge costs: Fire Storm (4), Wall Of Fire (3), Fireball (2), Burning Hands (1).
